title: 管控类化学品管理

author_source: project/高校实验室安全/045_管控类化学品管理/src.py

points.K4: 含砷样品和标准品按剧毒品管
points.K5: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
points.K6: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
points.K7: 爆炸物品：学生不私取、不自试
points.S1: 采购走学校平台，许可备案由学校办

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个上着两把锁的白色柜子旁报题
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a white cabinet secured with two locks and greets the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲管控类化学品管理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台前，发现缺一瓶试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student at a lab bench realizes one reagent bottle is missing from his kit.
shots.narration: 阿杰做实验，发现少了一瓶试剂。

shots.scene: 阿杰想去隔壁课题组借一瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student heads to the lab next door, about to borrow a bottle from a friend.
shots.narration: 他想去隔壁组，直接借一瓶。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着瓶子上的骷髅和锁图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a skull and lock icon on the bottle.
shots.narration: 小研：这是管控品，不能借！

shots.scene: 两人一起打开电脑查询
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student look up the reagent on a computer screen.
shots.narration: 先查清楚，它属于哪一类。

shots.scene: 三个分类图标：骷髅、试管加锁、爆炸加锁
shots.prompt_en: Three category icons: a skull, a locked test tube, and a locked burst symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆，国家专门管控。

shots.scene: 一本空白封面的目录和电脑屏幕上的搜索框
shots.prompt_en: A catalog with a blank cover next to a computer screen with an empty search box. No text.
shots.narration: 查危险化学品目录和相关名录。

shots.scene: 【实拍】本校化学品管理平台查询界面录屏（遮挡账号和个人信息）
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a chemical management web page with a search box and icons. No readable text.
shots.narration: 也可以在学校平台上查询。

shots.scene: 小研拿着手机给王老师打电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the safety administrator on her phone.
shots.narration: 属于这几类，先问清本校规定。

shots.scene: 采购、保管、领用三个图标连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons: a shopping cart, a locked cabinet, a hand taking a bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 采购、保管、领用，都要登记。

shots.scene: 天平上一小撮粉末和一大桶，两边都亮锁图标
shots.prompt_en: A tiny amount on a balance and a large drum, both glowing with a lock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 管不管控，看物质，不看用量。

shots.scene: 一小瓶管控品被单独放进专柜
shots.prompt_en: One small controlled reagent bottle is placed alone into a dedicated locked cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 哪怕只有一小瓶，也要专管。

shots.scene: 专区地面画线，门口有登记簿
shots.prompt_en: A marked dedicated storage area with a sign-in book at the entrance. No readable text.
shots.narration: 专柜专区，出入登记。

shots.scene: 管控品废液瓶单独放进收集箱，王老师登记
shots.prompt_en: A waste bottle from a controlled reagent goes into a separate collection box as the safety administrator logs it.
shots.narration: 用后的废弃物，也按专门规定处理。

shots.scene: 王老师翻看本校制度
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator flips through a blank-covered rule book.
shots.narration: 具体做法，以学校制度为准。

shots.scene: 骷髅图标和五个数字二的图标
shots.prompt_en: A skull icon surrounded by five paired-person icons. No text.
shots.narration: 剧毒化学品，实行“五双”管理。

shots.scene: 两人一起验收入库，核对箱子
shots.prompt_en: Two people check a delivery box together at the storage room door.
shots.narration: 双人验收，一起核对入库。

shots.scene: 两人分别负责一个柜子的看管
shots.prompt_en: Two people stand side by side guarding a locked cabinet.
shots.narration: 双人保管，不一人独管。

shots.scene: 两人一起领用，双人在场取出
shots.prompt_en: Two people are present together as a bottle is taken from the cabinet.
shots.narration: 双人领用，取用时双人在场。

shots.scene: 柜子上两把锁，两人各持一把钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet with two locks; two people each hold one key. No text.
shots.narration: 双把锁，两人各管一把钥匙。

shots.scene: 两本账本并排，数字一致打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two ledgers side by side with matching marks and a green check. No readable text.
shots.narration: 双本账，账账相符、账物相符。

shots.scene: 一个人同时拿两把钥匙，打叉
shots.prompt_en: One person holding both keys at once, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 两把钥匙，不能一人拿。

shots.scene: 王老师指着制度
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank rule sheet beside a locked cabinet.
shots.narration: “五双”具体内容，以本校制度为准。

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 传感器检测样品，屏幕上一个骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A sensor tests a water sample; its screen shows a skull icon. No text.
shots.narration: 检测砷要用含砷标准品。
overlay: 含砷样品和标准品按剧毒品管

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 含砷标准品小瓶放进双锁专柜
shots.prompt_en: A small standard vial with a skull icon goes into a double-locked cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 含砷标准品，按剧毒品专人专管。

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 领用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: A hand signs a blank sign-out ledger beside the vial. No readable text.
shots.narration: 领用要登记，用多少记多少。

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 含砷废液单独装瓶，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Waste liquid goes into its own labeled bottle, separate from other waste. No text.
shots.narration: 含砷废液单独收集，交学校处置。

shots.section_title: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
shots.scene: 试管加锁图标，一本空白封面的条例
shots.prompt_en: A locked test tube icon next to a regulation booklet with a blank cover. No text.
shots.narration: 易制毒化学品，国家专门立法管理。
overlay: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记

shots.section_title: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
shots.scene: 三个格子分成三类
shots.prompt_en: Three boxes side by side, each with a different number of dots. No text.
shots.narration: 易制毒化学品，分三类管理。

shots.section_title: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
shots.scene: 小研在领用单上签字，量筒只取一点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a requisition form and takes only a small amount.
shots.narration: 如乙酸酐，用多少领多少。

shots.section_title: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
shots.scene: 专柜加锁，台账记录入、出、存
shots.prompt_en: A locked dedicated cabinet beside a ledger with three blank columns. No readable text.
shots.narration: 专柜存放，专人管理，台账清楚。

shots.section_title: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
shots.scene: 试剂瓶递给别人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand passing a reagent bottle to another person, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不得私自转让、出借。

shots.section_title: 易制毒化学品：按规定领用登记
shots.scene: 用后废液分类收集，倒水槽打叉
shots.prompt_en: Used liquid is collected into a waste container; pouring into a sink is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 废液分类收集，不倒下水道。

shots.section_title: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
shots.scene: 爆炸图标加锁，一本空白封面的办法
shots.prompt_en: A locked burst icon next to a regulation booklet with a blank cover. No text.
shots.narration: 易制爆化学品，治安管理有专门办法。
overlay: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借

shots.section_title: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
shots.scene: 专柜存放，专人拿钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A locked dedicated cabinet; one assigned keeper holds the key.
shots.narration: 专柜存放，专人管理。

shots.section_title: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
shots.scene: 领用量和使用量两栏，如实记录
shots.prompt_en: A ledger with two blank columns for amount taken and amount used. No readable text.
shots.narration: 领了多少、用了多少，如实登记。

shots.section_title: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
shots.scene: 阿杰想把瓶子借给隔壁同学，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to lend a bottle to a classmate next door, crossed out.
shots.narration: 不外借、不转让、不私自带走。

shots.section_title: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
shots.scene: 流向箭头从购买到使用到处置，每一步都有登记图标
shots.prompt_en: Arrows flow from purchase to use to disposal, each step with a logbook icon. No text.
shots.narration: 购买到处置，流向都要可查。

shots.section_title: 易制爆化学品：专柜专人，不外借
shots.scene: 王老师指着规定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank rule sheet.
shots.narration: 具体按现行规定和学校制度。

shots.section_title: 爆炸物品：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 爆炸物品图标加锁，打叉的手
shots.prompt_en: A locked explosive icon with a reaching hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 爆炸物品，国家严格管控。
overlay: 爆炸物品：学生不私取、不自试

shots.section_title: 爆炸物品：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着手机看网上视频，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches a video on his phone and wants to try something, crossed out.
shots.narration: 学生不得自行获取、保存或试验。

shots.section_title: 爆炸物品：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 持资质证书的单位大门
shots.prompt_en: The entrance of a licensed facility with a certificate icon. No text.
shots.narration: 相关研究，由有资质的单位依规开展。

shots.section_title: 爆炸物品：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰向老周咨询
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student consult the older man.
shots.narration: 有疑问，先问导师和学院。

shots.section_title: 采购走学校平台，许可备案由学校办
shots.scene: 电脑上的采购平台，购物车图标
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen with a purchasing platform and a cart icon. No readable text.
shots.narration: 管控品只能通过学校平台采购。
overlay: 采购走学校平台，许可备案由学校办

shots.section_title: 采购走学校平台，许可备案由学校办
shots.scene: 个人网购包裹打叉
shots.prompt_en: A personal online shopping parcel, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不得个人私自购买。

shots.section_title: 采购走学校平台，许可备案由学校办
shots.scene: 审批流程：导师、学院、管理部门三个图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three approval icons in a row: supervisor, school office, management office, each ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 导师、学院、管理部门逐级审批。

shots.section_title: 采购走学校平台，许可备案由学校办
shots.scene: 学校盖章文件送到公安机关窗口
shots.prompt_en: A stamped document is handed to a police service window. No text.
shots.narration: 许可和备案，由学校统一办理。

shots.scene: 小研在天平前称量，旁边放着登记本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs a sample on a balance with a sign-out book beside her.
shots.narration: 管控品称量，按规定领用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在空白样表上填写领用登记：日期、用量、用途、签名（用空白样表示范，不出现真实品名）
shots.prompt_en: A hand fills in a blank sign-out form row by row with a pen. No readable text.
shots.narration: 称了多少、用在哪，如实登记。

shots.scene: 剩余的小瓶放回专柜
shots.prompt_en: The leftover small bottle is returned to the locked cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 剩余的，按规定退回专柜。

shots.scene: 账本数字和柜里瓶子对应打勾
shots.prompt_en: Ledger entries line up with bottles in the cabinet, a green check. No readable text.
shots.narration: 用多少记多少，账物相符。

shots.scene: 台账装订归档
shots.prompt_en: Completed ledgers are bound and filed on a shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 台账妥善保存，备查。

shots.scene: 专柜里少了一瓶，问号
shots.prompt_en: A gap in a row of bottles in the locked cabinet, a question mark above it. No text.
shots.narration: 发现丢失、被盗、账物不符……

shots.scene: 小研打电话，箭头依次指向老周、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a call; arrows point to the older man, a school office and the security officer.
shots.narration: 立即报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接电话，旁边有警徽图标
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers the phone beside a police badge icon.
shots.narration: 学校按规定报告公安机关。

shots.scene: 瞒报的手打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand hiding a ledger behind its back, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不瞒报、不迟报、不自己找。

shots.scene: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆三个图标加锁打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three locked icons for the three controlled categories, each with a green check. No text.
shots.narration: 先认出管控品，看物质不看量。

shots.scene: 五双、专柜、台账三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of paired people, a locked cabinet and a ledger. No text.
shots.narration: 剧毒“五双”，专柜专人，如实登记。

shots.scene: 平台采购、不外借、立即报告三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a purchase screen, a crossed-out handover and a phone. No text.
shots.narration: 平台采购，不外借，丢失立即报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在易燃品柜旁，远处有火焰图标，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a flammable storage cabinet with a flame icon and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：易燃易爆化学品。
